verdict.rationale: Discord documents two official SDKs: the Embedded App SDK for in-Discord web apps and games, and the Discord Social SDK with getting-started guides for C++, Unity, Unreal Engine, and iOS/Android. However, the core bot and REST/Gateway API surface has no documented official SDK; it is covered only by raw API docs and a preview OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an official SDK for the bot/REST/Gateway API, SDK coverage for general-purpose (non-game) languages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
